name: Citizenship by Birth in Territory or by Descent

requirements.blocker_text: Lei n. 2/16 (Angola's Nationality Law): a child born in Angola to at least one Angolan parent acquires Angolan nationality automatically at birth. Foundlings discovered in Angolan territory are presumed Angolan citizens of origin. Separately, Article 11 allows a non-citizen child of a parent who subsequently acquires Angolan nationality (e.g. through the parent's own naturalization) to request citizenship through their legal representative -- a distinct, secondary route from the birth-based rule.
requirements.fix_path: Establish birth in Angolan territory with at least one Angolan parent, or (for a foundling) discovery within Angolan territory, to acquire nationality automatically; obtain an Angolan birth certificate as proof.

evidence_required.document: Birth certificate showing parental link or place of birth

sources.title: LEX.AO (Angolan legal-text database, quoting Lei n. 2/16 verbatim) -- birth/descent nationality rule, foundling presumption, Article 11's secondary route via a naturalizing parent

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Angola).
